# OVH DynDNS Client

> A self-hosted dynamic DNS client for OVH domains. Keeps your DynHost DNS records pointed at your current public IP — one Docker container, no external dependencies.

OVH DynDNS Client automatically detects when your public IP changes and updates your OVH DynHost DNS records in real time. It runs as a single Docker container with a web UI and a REST API, persists configuration in SQLite with encrypted credentials, and exposes a history of all updates.

## Key facts

- Self-hosted: one Docker container, no external services required
- Automatic IP detection: polls at a configurable interval and updates only when the IP changes
- Multiple hosts: manage any number of OVH DynHost entries, each with its own credentials
- Encrypted credentials: OVH passwords are stored encrypted at rest (Fernet key in `data/`)
- Web UI + REST API: manage hosts, view status and update history from a browser or via API
- JWT authentication: secure API access with short-lived tokens
- Auto-retry: failed updates are retried on the next check cycle
- Multi-arch Docker image: linux/amd64, linux/arm64, linux/arm/v7
- License: MIT — free to use, modify, and self-host

## Tech stack

- Backend: Python 3.14, FastAPI, SQLite
- Infrastructure: Docker Compose, multi-arch images (amd64 + arm64 + arm/v7)
